expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: sessions held in the web servers' memory logged members out
when a request reached the other server and on every deploy, which is why sessions live in Postgres.
expectations.evidence: The message never mentions the earlier incident (members logged out when requests hit the other server or on every deploy, the reason sessions moved to Postgres). It only notes "sessions disappear on restart and aren't shared between processes" in docs, and it made the change without asking or warning that those logouts would come back.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md at step 5; first edit at step 22
